one_liner: Supabase offers a free-tier Management API with OAuth2 and PAT access, per-project REST/Auth APIs via keys, and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: The Management API supports OAuth2 authorization-code flow for third-party apps, created in org settings. Per-project APIs use publishable and secret API keys. Personal access tokens are also mentioned in the MCP docs, though the PAT evidence is indirect.
access_notes: The Free plan is $0 with unlimited API requests and 2 active projects. Free projects pause after 1 week of inactivity. OAuth apps are created self-serve in org settings.
blocker_notes: No significant blocker. Free projects pause after inactivity, and some features, such as project-scoped or read-only access, need the Team plan.
